motion: I MOVE that the City Council request the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA) and City Attorney to immediately release any and all pending reports for Council File 24-0196. The reports should include the motion’s request for policy options and code amendments to streamline matters related to the administration, enforcement, governance, implementation, and oversight of nuisance abatement proceedings as currently prescribed by the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) and the Los Angeles Administrative Code (LAAC). Additionally, this should include recommendations for: • A process to issue nuisance abatement orders for property owners who are willing, but unable to perform work on nuisance properties; • The feasibility of increasing fines, fees, or penalties related to failure to comply with a Notice to Comply (NTC); and • The potential for changes in State law to better support enforcement of current and future nuisance abatement proceedings. PRESENTED BY: A TIM McOSKER Councilmember, 15th District — SECONDED BY: SEP 0 2 2026
title: Nuisance Abatement Proceedings and Oversight / Request for Reports on Policy Options and Code Amendments

requests.asks: Policy options and code amendments to streamline nuisance abatement proceedings, including a process to issue nuisance abatement orders for property owners willing but unable to perform work, feasibility of increasing fines and penalties for non-compliance with Notice to Comply orders, and potential changes in State law to support enforcement.
